description: The UE in state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED initiates the registration procedure for initial registration by sending a REGISTRATION REQUEST message to the AMF under various conditions.

reasons: Initial registration for SMS over NAS
Initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN
Initial registration for disaster roaming services
Initial registration to come out of unavailability period and resume normal services

properties.description: UE handles the 5GS mobile identity IE based on conditions like previous registration in S1 mode, available 5G-GUTI, SUCI, etc.

properties.condition: SUCI is included and T3519 is not running
UE is operating in dual-registration mode and in EMM-REGISTERED state
properties.action: Include UE status IE with EMM registration status set to UE is in EMM-REGISTERED state

properties.condition: Last visited registered TAI is available

properties.action: Include 5GS update type IE with SMS requested bit set to SMS over NAS supported

properties.condition: UE supports and requests MICO mode
UE needs to use UE specific DRX parameters
Based on Allowed and Configured NSSAI
properties.action: Include requested NSSAI IE based on Allowed and Configured NSSAI.

properties.description: Set different 5GMM capability bits based on UE support for features like NSAG, RACS, V2X, UAS, ProSe, MINT, etc.

properties.condition: If UE has stored UE policy sections.
properties.action: set the Payload container type IE to UE policy container and include the UE STATE INDICATION message

properties.condition: UE has a valid 5G NAS security context or not
properties.action: Include or exclude NAS message container IE based on security context

properties.condition: If the UE supports ciphered broadcast assistance data and needs to obtain new ciphering keys
properties.action: Include the Additional information requested IE with the CipherKey bit set to ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data requested

edges.action: Send REGISTRATION REQUEST message to AMF
Stop timer T3502 and T3511 if running
check  UE is operating in dual-registration mode and in EMM-REGISTERED state
Check  Last visited registered TAI is available
Check UE requests SMS over NAS
Check  UE supports and requests MICO mode
check  UE needs to use UE specific DRX parameters
Set 5GMM capabilities based on UE support
